scenarios.name: cooldown_fresh_incoming
scenarios.given: assistant active, conversation ai, cooldown_seconds=60, last AI reply 20 seconds ago
scenarios.when: new persisted incoming message is received
expect: no automatic reply before the remaining 40 seconds

scenarios.name: cooldown_queue_after_due
scenarios.given: pending ai.cooldown and at least 60 seconds elapsed since last AI reply
expect: automatic cron does not bypass cooldown

scenarios.name: cooldown_human_takeover
scenarios.when: human takes over before queue processing
